$description: Shared by every image preset (Mesh-Refracted-Pattern and Mesh-Sliced-Pattern). Change a value here and all of them update.

source.$description: The source rule, used by canUseImage() in patterns/library.js. When an image is approved in the Design Lab library and passes this rule, the tool makes its meshes (meshesForImage) and saves them with the image. Patterns then pick any image that has meshes, so the patterns grow with the library.
source.pick: random among library images that have meshes
never: Images with the mascot in them, even when the asset type is image. Asset type alone isn't enough, so prompts that mention the mascot or a robot are skipped, and a person should confirm new images.
Luma or event promo images (asset type event)

mesh.$description: Every mesh point is snapped to the closest token from this list: whole families, or single steps like neutral.950. No grays: light areas use pastel primary and secondary steps and white, dark areas use the deep violets, reds and neutral.950.

$examplesNote: Test examples. Each has a mesh per look in meshes/<id>.<meshGroup>.json. The PNGs aren't kept: the library link is enough to rebuild a mesh if the grade, blur or contrast change.
